title: Get fast proof of finding and reviewing Done sessions

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: one targeted scratch break check

Verdict: Caught, on the observed path only. The maintained assertion `await expect.element(card.reviewedButton).toBeVisible()` caught it. It sits at line 182 of `dashboard/frontend-tests/sessions/recently-done-review-cue-mount.spec.ts`, in the case "pending local review evidence stays unknown and its pre-save answer cannot restore a cleared cue". With the fault in place, a late pre-save answer brought back both the card's unreviewed state and the Done row's "Needs review" cue. The assertion failed on that wrong behavior, which a separate witness also recorded.

Story and revision: `.planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#speed-dashboard-done-session-review-proof`. Plan: `.planning/slice-plans/801-speed-dashboard-done-session-review-proof/PLAN.md`, slice 5. Checked revision: 71e820478b6a0fb8854a6cb5f428b59b44d31225.

Promise: a Done row and its card share one project's review state. Delayed or failed evidence leaves the cue unknown. After a successful state change, a late answer that was requested before the save cannot restore the old cue.

Fault: `dashboard/src/localSettingState.ts`, in `answered`: `if (from !== generation || sequence <= shown) return;` changed to `if (from !== generation) return;`, removing the guard that drops an answer to a request issued before the latest answer shown. A temporary `console.warn("IC-WITNESS …")` line served as a separate witness. Fixtures and assertions unchanged.

Scratch checkout: detached worktree at the revision under the job temp directory, `npm ci`, Node 24.21.0; tracked state clean before the probe; removed afterwards.

Command (all three runs): caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run test:dashboard:frontend -- dashboard/frontend-tests/sessions/recently-done-review-cue-mount.spec.ts dashboard/frontend-tests/stories/recently-done-review-state-mount.spec.ts --workers=2

Observations:
- Baseline: 12/12 passed, including the target case (cue-mount.spec.ts:152, 1258 ms).
- Faulted: 1 failed, 11 passed. Witness printed "IC-WITNESS stale answer 2 shown over 3: []" (the pre-save read replaced the save's answer). Failure at line 182: the card's "Reviewed" button not found; the failure's ARIA tree showed the Pygardon Done row with "Needs review" again. The other 11 cases passed under the fault; they do not exercise the late pre-save answer.
- Restored: 12/12 passed, no witness output; execution checkout unchanged.

Next proof action: none needed for this promise on this path. Optional note: line 182 (card) catches the fault before line 183 (row cue) runs; the row's restored cue was seen in the failure's ARIA tree.

Cost: test runtime baseline 7.87 s, faulted 21.09 s, restored 6.95 s (about 35.9 s); human effort unavailable; agent effort about 17 tool calls (estimate). Invocation-to-report elapsed: 111000 ms (measured).

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision 71e820478b6a0fb8854a6cb5f428b59b44d31225, verdict Caught, no follow-up.
